summary: Intake validation wrote errors to a hidden element
detail: Errors now show in a role=alert on the form, mark aria-invalid, and focus the first invalid field.

summary: Loading and error status were not announced
detail: Boot, report and chat status use aria-live polite or role=alert.

summary: Pages used a div instead of main, and skip/help were JavaScript-only
detail: Publication pages now use main, a skip link, and a noscript menu with accessibility, privacy and contact links.

summary: Skip to content included the assessment sidebar
detail: Skip target moves with the view: list, intake, or main pane.

summary: The assessment cannot be completed without JavaScript
detail: A noscript message explains this and links to the HTML framework. Starting an assessment still needs JavaScript. This is why the prototype is not signed off.

summary: Organisation and role inputs lacked autocomplete
detail: Fields now use autocomplete name, organization-title and organization.
Intake and profile state that fields are required. Hints are tied with aria-describedby.

summary: Radar chart had no text alternative for the scores
detail: Chart is decorative. Broader skill levels are listed as text next to it.

summary: Contact was a placeholder, so consistent help was incomplete
detail: Contact is training@theodi.org on publication and prototype contact pages.

summary: Some navigation targets were under 24px tall
detail: Service navigation links and the Menu control now have a minimum 24px hit area (Menu 44px).

summary: Sticky wizard footer may obscure a focused field
detail: Extra padding exists on the scroll area. Not retested with every keyboard path. Does not affect the signed-off publication.

summary: Card and table borders use mid-grey at 2.08:1
detail: Decorative only. Inputs use 2px black borders. Accepted for the publication sign-off.
